status: PROPOSAL -- NOT FROZEN AND NOT A PREREGISTRATION. Amended by the maintainer 2026-10-18 (single draw per dose). The formal phase opens only on plans/volume_preregistration.json; writing it needs the funding decision below.
supersedes: formal_design_proposal v1 (three independent resamples per dose), withdrawn by the maintainer's amendment; its record is in git history

fixed.method: the forward baseline, resolved through shared.forward_baseline (stage1_init.d1_target_aware.scored_v1@v1) -- never edited to save cost
fixed.recovery_seed: one, identical for all three doses
fixed.evaluation_contract: data/eval-set/eval-set-1 at its registered identity, every unit and capability reported separately (AGENTS.md P10.3)

treatments.draws: ONE nested draw: the 2x set contains the 1x set and the 4x set the 2x set, from one frozen base mixture (the pilot's weights: 0.18 per static primary axis, 0.28 supporting) and its frozen reasoning-heavy variant; no independent resamples
treatments.per_treatment: one D1 full search (beam width 6, delayed_prune warm-up 1, pareto@v2) with operator order and the profile per operator FREE over the two mixtures at that dose; the committed Top-1 recovered once under the fixed recipe and seed; eval-set-1 measured once
treatments.covariate_rule: rule-family diversity rises with dose in the pilot draws (10-12, 15-17, 18-22): any H1/H2 difference is reported as a volume+diversity contrast, never as a pure volume effect
treatments.hardware: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB: 8,192-token pool items OOM DEPTH on a 44 GiB card

claims.allowed: comparisons between these three specific treatments
not_allowed: selection variance or stability (needs resamples; the pilot's root-level resampled measurement remains the only one)
statistical saturation (H3 is described, never tested)
a pure volume effect where composition changed with dose

endpoints.H1: descriptive: the committed Top-1 of each dose -- operator order, per-step profile, and per operator FFN/ATTENTION per-layer Jaccard, DEPTH removed-set Jaccard, WIDTH subspace overlap between doses (2x vs 1x, 4x vs 2x, 4x vs 1x), each beside chance; no stability claim
endpoints.H2: eval-set-1, every unit and capability separately; primary = fluid_reasoning_720 static items pooled over the four static axes and per axis, interactive separately; supporting and guard-rail units reported beside it; stage3_legacy_150 only as in-sample regression
endpoints.H3: the 1x/2x/4x shape of H1 and H2, described

statistics.inference: task-paired contrasts 2x-1x, 4x-2x, 4x-1x with a rule-family cluster bootstrap (10,000 resamples, stratified by axis); the interval covers EVALUATION sampling only -- training-seed and selection variance are unmeasured with one draw and one seed, and every verdict says so

decision.GO: a contrast's interval lies wholly above +SESOI
decision.SATURATION: never declared; a 2x-1x GO with a 4x-2x NO-GO is reported as 'consistent with saturation for these treatments' only

resolution_gate.before_any_search: the reference check (configs/.../resolution_session.json): does fluid_reasoning_720 resolve models in the student's capacity range? result: logs/stages/stage-0/calibration_volume/design/resolution_check.json
resolution_gate.after_the_1x_unit: the 1x recovered D1-initialized student must answer at least 2% of fluid_reasoning_720's static items; below it H2 is EVALUATION NOT RESOLVABLE (measured on a D1 student, not assumed from PCA students) and the 2x/4x sessions are not launched without a new maintainer decision
resolution_gate.why: every fixed-recipe student measured so far is PCA-initialized and inside the floor (0/720, 0/720, 10/720); whether a D1-initialized one is has not been measured

split_execution_of_4x.why: its hard cap exceeds the $30 per-session cap
mechanism: one network volume (the provider's persistent disk, ONE datacenter) holds the search workdir: the state journal and every materialized state
part 1 runs the search with the treatment's plan; the watchdog's hard stop or a planned stop ends it; nothing is collected but the journal tail and telemetry

part 2 attaches the same volume (same datacenter), runs the IDENTICAL plan, config, seed, profiles and baseline resolution; the engine restores every journaled state by content-derived id and hash-checks it from disk, and continues the first unfinished expansion

identity check: part 2's search config hash, materialization protocol and measurement protocol must equal part 1's; any declined restore (telemetry `restore_declined`) is a stop condition, not a silent re-measure
the final record carries both sessions' run ids, n_resumed, and the volume id
engineering_not_yet_built: search_driver: --workdir on the volume and a resume mode that asserts the identity check above (the engine already resumes)
launch: attach --network-volume-id / --volume-mount-path (SessionRunner already supports both) and a 4x two-part plan
a $0 CPU test: stop a tiny-model search mid-tree, resume, and compare the final journal with an uninterrupted run
creating the volume is a paid provider action inside the formal budget

durable_artifacts: each dose's committed Top-1 init and its recovered student (~2.4 GB each) must survive a later failure (P8.2.1): the network volume is the durable store during the study; the HF relay's private quota is full, so archival retention after the study is a maintainer decision
